enriched.summary: São as palavras que eu esqueço durante as práticas dos exercicios

vocabulary.definition: used to introduce a surprising fact despite what was just mentioned
examples: She was tired; even so, she kept working.
It was raining; even so, they went for a walk.
The movie was long; even so, I enjoyed it.
He apologized; even so, she was still upset.
The task was difficult; even so, they managed to finish it.

vocabulary.definition: used to describe something that improves upon a previous situation or thing
examples: This cake is good, but the chocolate one is even better.
I thought the movie was great, but the sequel was even better.
She did well in her first performance, but her second one was even better.
The weather today is even better than yesterday.
Their new album is even better than the last one.

vocabulary.definition: used to describe something that is more negative than another thing
examples: The weather was bad yesterday, but today it's even worse.
I was late for the meeting, and even worse, I forgot my notes.
The situation is bad, but it could get even worse.
He failed the test, and even worse, he didn’t study at all.
The traffic is bad now, but during rush hour it gets even worse.

vocabulary.definition: to be able to pay for or do something
examples: I can't afford a new car.
She can afford to travel abroad every year.
We can't afford to waste time.
He couldn't afford the luxury hotel.
Can you afford this expensive gift?

vocabulary.definition: in or to a foreign country
examples: She studied abroad for a year.
They want to travel abroad next summer.
Many students dream of working abroad.
The news quickly spread abroad.
He moved abroad after retiring.
The project is ongoing.
There is an ongoing investigation.
Her support has been ongoing.
The ongoing debate is intense.
We must address the ongoing issues.

vocabulary.definition: to greet or call out to someone; frozen rain drops
examples: The crowd hailed the hero.
She hailed a taxi after the party.
Hail covered the streets after the storm.
They hailed the new policy as a success.
The farmer feared the hail would damage the crops.

vocabulary.definition: The act of landing a spacecraft on the moon.
examples: The first moon landing happened in 1969.
Scientists studied the effects of the moon landing.
The moon landing was broadcast worldwide.
Astronauts trained for the moon landing mission.
The moon landing marked a new era in space exploration.

vocabulary.definition: to direct or point towards a target or goal
examples: She aimed at the target.
His aim is to become a doctor.
You should aim for success.
They aimed the camera at the stage.
Our aim is to improve education.
I will call you soon.
The movie starts soon.
She'll be here soon.
We hope to visit you soon.
Soon, everything will be ready.
His son is very talented.
They named their son John.
She is proud of her son.
The father hugged his son tightly.
Their son is studying abroad.

vocabulary.definition: having a moderate degree of heat; not cold.
examples: The soup is warm.
She gave me a warm smile.
The weather is warm today.
Please keep the room warm.
He enjoys warm tea in the evening.

vocabulary.definition: having a large distance between opposite sides.
examples: The book has thick pages.
She wore a thick coat to stay warm.
The fog was so thick they couldn't see ahead.
He sliced the bread into thick pieces.
The forest is thick with trees.

vocabulary.definition: a thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in water, often flavored.
examples: She poured syrup over her pancakes.
The medicine comes in a syrup form.
Maple syrup is a popular topping for waffles.
Add some chocolate syrup to the milk.
The recipe calls for sugar syrup.

vocabulary.definition: the process of cooking food using dry heat, typically in an oven.
examples: She enjoys baking cakes on weekends.
Baking bread takes patience and skill.
I'm baking cookies for the party.
He started a baking business from home.
Baking can be a relaxing hobby.

vocabulary.definition: to increase in size, amount, or develop
examples: Plants grow with sunlight.
He wants to grow his business.
Children grow quickly.
Her confidence grew over time.
They grow vegetables in their garden.
The government issued new guidelines.
She issued a statement to the press.
A warning was issued to residents.
The bank issued him a new credit card.
The company issued a refund for the faulty product.
